Past and upcoming earnings reports for one symbol, oldest first. The list has the last `past` reports before today (actual EPS, actual revenue and surprise percentages) and the reports from today to `days` ahead. Read `status` to tell them apart: `reported` or `no_data` for past reports, `upcoming` for the next one.
